card.text: Small Mars-crossing asteroid that Deep Space 1 flew past.

sources.label: JPL Small-Body Database
sources.quote: 9969 Braille (1992 KD); Discovered 1992 May 27 by E. F. Helin and K. J. Lawrence at Palomar.; orbit class: Mars-crossing Asteroid; q: 1.32 au

introduction.text: E. F. Helin and K. J. Lawrence found Braille at Palomar in 1992. It turns very slowly, about once every 226 hours.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.summary: A coarse shape from brightness changes as it spins, with the proportions Deep Space 1 saw. The spin angle shown is arbitrary.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 0.595 km sphere, sharing the size uncertainty. Colors mix the overall shape with local relief.
